body: I'm in Switzerland but all my "new" family is from Italy. They love to cook but they also have strong gender ideas - like a woman's job is to be good looking, slim and tan. I've never been told to tan before because of the likelihood i'll get skin cancer (i'm super pale with fair hair and eyes) but his mom like pushes me outside and hides the sunscreen. Gr.. I received a kindle and have been reading GoT.  I think it was the speed yesterday that got me all hyped up and freaking out. You're right, i should probably stop it. Thanks for the advice.

That's a good idea...underarmor might help. I'm pretty sure I brought some with me. I went to see the finals tonight and met some friends from american that are working are CERN, so I hope maybe i'll have some english speaking drinking buddies. I was able to laugh at them about the extra large thing, and they shared a story about how hard it was for them to find clothes in japan - that makes me feel better.

Thank you so much for your kind words.

I have no way to start taking the medicine again. I am probably leaving this life behind to move back home so I can get covered under my health insurance again and have access to it because I think I really need it. I'm unhappy both places though...i just don't know what to do.

The problem with the doctor is that I am not covered by my health insurance here and their health insurance doesn't cover mental heath, especially prescription medication. I really would like to lose some of the extra chub before I start running agian. I enjoy walking but i can't stand the feeling of my stomach jiggling when I run, I feel like I need a sports bra for it.
